grades.quote: The compare instructions follow the semantics of the scalar floating-point compare instructions. `vmfeq` and `vmfne` raise the invalid operation exception only on signaling NaN inputs. `vmflt` , `vmfle` , `vmfgt` , and `vmfge` raise the invalid operation exception on both signaling and quiet NaN inputs. `vmfne` writes 1 to the destination element when either operand is NaN, whereas the other compares write 0 when either operand is NaN.
